# Change record template

Copy into CHANGELOG.md (short form) and, for significant changes, into the
relevant doc.

```
## YYYY-MM-DD — <short title>

- **Phase:** <n>
- **Objective:** <why>
- **Previous state:** <what it was, with evidence>
- **Change performed:** <what was done; OMV UI path or exact commands>
- **Affected devices/paths:** <by serial / UUID / path — not only /dev/sdX>
- **Approval:** <who approved, when>
- **Result / verification:** <commands + observed output summary>
- **Rollback:** <how to undo, or "not reversible" + why accepted>
- **Docs updated:** <files>
```
